text_block_list.text:
Right before summer camp ends, I'm
looking for
Найс Нэйчер, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I won't be able to see this for a
while...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: And I wanted to reflect on some stuff.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'm... stronger than I was before summer
camp,
right?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Doesn't just being by the sea make you

emotional? There's a reason it's a primo
date
spot.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess I'll go back. I've got my
mind all
ready now.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Ready for the autumn Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And with that, Найс Нэйчер's summer
camp comes
to an end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
